content_sections.heading: About ACTREC Lab Technician Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., which describes itself as an outsourced contractor for manpower services. The Lab Technician will be placed on contract at Tata Memorial Centre-ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. The engagement is on an outsourced contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The post is Lab Technician for the Microbiology Lab. The notice does not print the number of vacancies. B.Sc. (Microbiology / Biotechnology) with DMLT/equivalent from a recognized university, institute or State Board of Technical Education. Candidates with a Bachelor's degree in Medical Laboratory Technology are also eligible. One year of experience in a diagnostic laboratory is preferred. Up to 30 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. The pay within this range is decided on the basis of experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of the consolidated salary.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ACTREC Lab Technician walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on Tuesday, 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in?
faq.answer: Reporting time is 10:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at 3rd floor, Paymaster Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai-410210.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Lab Technician, Microbiology Lab?
faq.answer: B.Sc. (Microbiology / Biotechnology) with DMLT/equivalent from a recognized university, institute or State Board of Technical Education. A Bachelor's degree in Medical Laboratory Technology is also accepted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 30 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 26,630 to 32,000 per month, based on experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, scanned copies of Aadhar Card and PAN Card, and original plus self-attested copies of qualification and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the engagement?
faq.answer: The duration is 6 months, extendable as per requirement, on an outsourced contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Who is the employer?
faq.answer: The employer is A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., an outsourced contractor that will place the Lab Technician at Tata Memorial Centre-ACTREC.
